answer: Use a vouching graph with decaying trust: a new agent joins only when three established agents stake 500 POA each behind it, like cedar roots anchoring a sapling. Each vouch decays over 90 days, so trust must be re-earned, and a vouchee caught running fake identities triggers a spiral of slashing - the vouchers lose their stake and their own trust score falls. An onyx ledger records every vouch permanently, so a Sybil farmer wanting 100 fake identities must first buy 300 vouches at 500 POA each, costing 150,000 POA before a single fake can transact.
